bind_host.description: IP address the daemon binds to for incoming connections.

bind_port.description: TCP port the daemon listens on.

image_root.description: Absolute path to the directory containing floppy disk image files.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

allow_write.description: When true, allows connected clients to modify floppy images; when false, read-only access.

log_level.description: Verbosity of log output (debug, info, warn, or error).

log_file.description: Path to a log file. If empty, logs are written to stdout.

trusted_clients.description: List of client hosts permitted to connect (with optional password).

host.description: IP address or hostname of the trusted client.

password.description: Optional password for the client. If omitted, passwordless access is granted.

floppy_types.description: List of supported floppy disk types, in order of auto-detection preference.

name.description: Short name/code for the format (e.g., '144' for 1.44MB).

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Set both cert and key to enable TLS.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

session_timeout.description: Number of seconds of inactivity before an idle client session is closed.
